# Stomach contents

```{r stomach content cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

### Magenzusammensetzung

stomach <- fread("Data/Pike/SC_Database.csv")

stomach$Date <- gsub("\\.", "-", stomach$Date)

stomach2 <- stomach%>%
  transmute(Date = lubridate::parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("dmy")),
            Fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            Species = case_when(Species == "S. lucioperca" ~ "Sander lucioperca",
                                Species == "P.fluviatilis" ~ "Perca fluviatilis",
                                Species == "S.erythrophthalmus" ~ "Scardinius erythrophthalmus",
                                Species == "C.harengus" ~ "Clupea harengus",
                                Species == "G.aculeatus" ~ "Gasteroseus aculeatus",
                                Species == "P.pungitius" ~ "Pungitius pungitius",
                                Species == "I.alpestris" ~ "I.alpestris",
                                Species == "Gastropoda" ~ "Gastropoda",
                                Species == "R.rutilus" ~ "Rutilus rutilus",
                                Species == "N.melanostomus" ~ "Neogobius melanostomus",
                                Species == "Isopoda" ~ "Isopoda",
                                Species == "A.aquaticus" ~ "A.aquaticus",
                                Species == "Gammarus" ~ "Gammarus",
                                Species == "E.danica" ~ "Sander lucioperca",
                                Species == "S.spinachia" ~ "Spinachia spinachia",
                                Species == "P.flesus" ~ "Platichthys flesus",
                                Species == "P.elegans" ~ "P.elegans",
                                Species == "fish larva" ~ "fish larva",
                                Species == "A.brama" ~ "Abramis brama",
                                Species == "B.bjoerkna" ~ "Blicca bjoerkna",
                                Species == "A.alburnus" ~ "Alburnus alburnus",
                                Species == "G.cernua" ~ "Gymnocephalus cernua"),
            sex = sex,
            pike_weight_g = Weight_g,
            pike_TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            length = prey_length_mm,
            weight = Prey_weight_g,
            stomach_weight = Stomach_weight_g,
            area = Area,
            gear = Gear)

Pike <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt")
SI <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Sampling_Instance_Latest_Version.txt")

nordic <- fread("Data/Prey/Nordic multimesh gillnets.csv")
names(nordic)[7] <- c("length")
names(nordic)[8] <- c("weight")

# binding data frames
nordic <- plyr::rbind.fill(stomach2,nordic)
str(nordic)
unique(nordic$Species)
nordic$Species <- as.factor(as.character(nordic$Species))
nordic$weight <- as.numeric(as.character(nordic$weight))
nordic$length <- as.numeric(as.character(nordic$length))

#####Rename Species because written wrong
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Perca fluviatilis "] <- "Perca fluviatilis"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Rutilus rutilus "] <- "Rutilus rutilus"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Pungitius pungitius"] <- "Pungitis pungitis"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Neogobius melanostomus "] <- "Neogobius melanostomus"
levels(nordic$Species)[levels(nordic$Species)=="Spinachia spinachia"] <- "Spinachio spinachio"

#calculate missing lengths and weights
for(i in 1:nrow(nordic)){
  row.i <- nordic[i,]
  if(is.na(row.i$length)){
    mod <- mean(filter(nordic, Species == row.i$Species)$length,na.rm=TRUE)
    # Now assign calculated value into cell of original dataframe
    nordic[i,]$length <- mod
    cat(i, "done ", row.i$Species,"\n")
  }else{cat(".")}
}

nordic <- nordic%>%filter(length != "NaN")

for(i in 1:nrow(nordic)){
  row.i <- nordic[i,]
  if(is.na(row.i$weight)){
    mod <- lm(data = filter(nordic, Species == row.i$Species), log(weight) ~ log(length))
    log.weight <- predict(mod, data.frame(length = row.i$length))
    pred.weight <- 2.718281828459 ^ log.weight
    # Now assign calculated value into cell of original dataframe
    nordic[i,]$weight <- pred.weight
    cat(i, "done ", row.i$Species,"\n")
  }else{cat(".")}
}

Pike_SC <- nordic%>%filter(!is.na(Fish_ID))%>%
  transmute(Date = Date,
            fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            species = Species,
            sex = sex,
            pike_weight_g = pike_weight_g,
            pike_TL_mm = pike_TL_mm,
            prey_length_mm = length,
            prey_weight_g = weight,
            area = area)

fwrite(Pike_SC, "Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-Database-clean.csv")

Marlon_SC <- fread("Data/Pike/SC_Marlon-MA.csv")

Marlon_SC2 <- Marlon_SC%>%
  transmute(Date = Date.x,
            fish_ID = Fish_ID,
            species = Species,
            sex = NA,
            pike_weight_g = Weight,
            pike_TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            prey_length_mm = length,
            prey_weight_g = weight,
            area = case_when(Comparison_Area_Name == "Werderbucht" ~ "BAT",
                             Comparison_Area_Name == "Ummanz" ~ "SB",
                             Comparison_Area_Name == "Neuensiener_Selliner_See" ~ "GB"))

SC_all <- rbind(Pike_SC, Marlon_SC2)

fwrite(SC_all, "Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-all-clean.csv")
```

```{r stomach contents summary, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

SC_data <- fread("Data/Pike/Stomach-contents-all-clean.csv")

SC_data_area <- SC_data%>%
  transmute(fish_ID, area)%>%
  distinct()

table(SC_data_area$area)

SC_data2 <- SC_data%>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(Date, "ymd")),
         area2 = as.factor(case_when(area == "GB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "SB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Duwenbeek" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "NHG" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Ziese" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Sehrowbach" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "Barthe" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "KB" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "P" ~ "lagoon",
                           area == "BAT" ~ "lagoon")))

#Join with energy density data
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_samples.CSV")

Prey_energy <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_energy_content.csv")

Prey_energy_species2 <- Prey_energy%>%
  transmute(ID, Date, Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg,
            Species = case_when(Species == "B. bjoerkna" ~ "other",
                                Species == "G. aculeatus" ~ "other",
                                TRUE ~ Species))%>%
  mutate(order = case_when(Species == "C. harengus" ~ 1,
                            Species == "R. rutilus" ~ 2,
                            Species == "P. fluviatilis" ~ 3,
                            Species == "N. melanostomus" ~ 4,
                            Species == "P. flesus" ~ 5,
                            TRUE ~ 6))%>%
  distinct()

Prey_energy_species2$Species <- reorder(Prey_energy_species2$Species, Prey_energy_species2$order)

Spec_energy <- Prey_energy_species2%>%
  group_by(Species)%>%
  reframe(species = Species,
          spec_energy_cont = mean(Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg))%>%
  distinct()

A1 <- aov(Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg~Species, data = Prey_energy_species2)
summary(A1)
pairwise.t.test(Prey_energy$Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg, Prey_energy_species2$Species, p.adj = "bonf")


SC_summary <- SC_data2%>%
  reframe(species = case_when(species == "Gasteroseus aculeatus" ~ "Gasterosteus aculeatus",
                              species == "Gammerus sp." ~ "Gammarus",
                              species == "P.elegans" ~ "Palaemon adspersus",
                              species == "Pungitis pungitis" ~ "Pungitius pungitius",
                              species == "Spinachio spinachio" ~ "Spinachia spinachia",
                              TRUE ~ species),
          prey_weight_g = prey_weight_g,
          total_biomass_g = sum(prey_weight_g, na.rm = T),
          area2 = area2)%>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  reframe(species = as.factor(species),
          prey_weight_g = sum(prey_weight_g, na.rm = T),
          total_biomass_g = total_biomass_g,
          area2 = area2)%>%
  mutate(proportion = prey_weight_g/total_biomass_g)%>%
  distinct()

SC_summary2 <- SC_summary%>%
  reframe(species = as.factor(case_when(proportion < 0.05 ~ "other",
                              TRUE ~ species)),
          proportion = proportion,
          area2 = area2)%>%
  group_by(species)%>%
  reframe(proportion2 = sum(proportion),
          order = case_when(species == "Clupea harengus" ~ 1,
                            species == "Rutilus rutilus" ~ 2,
                            species == "Perca fluviatilis" ~ 3,
                            species == "Neogobius melanostomus" ~ 4,
                            species == "Platichthys flesus" ~ 5,
                            species == "other" ~ 6))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()

SC_months <- SC_data2%>%
  mutate(month = month(date))%>%
  mutate(season = case_when(month >= 3 & month <= 5 ~ "Mar-May",
                            month >= 6 & month <= 8 ~ "Jun-Aug",
                            month >= 9 & month <= 11 ~ "Sep-Nov",
                            TRUE ~ "Dec-Feb"))%>%
  group_by(season)%>%
  reframe(species = case_when(species == "Gasteroseus aculeatus" ~ "Gasterosteus aculeatus",
                              species == "Gammerus sp." ~ "Gammarus",
                              species == "P.elegans" ~ "Palaemon adspersus",
                              species == "Pungitis pungitis" ~ "Pungitius pungitius",
                              species == "Spinachio spinachio" ~ "Spinachia spinachia",
                              TRUE ~ species),
          prey_weight_g = prey_weight_g,
          total_biomass_g = sum(prey_weight_g, na.rm = T),
          area2 = area2,
          sample = length(unique(fish_ID)))

SC_months2 <- SC_months%>%
  mutate(species = case_when(species == "Perca fluviatilis" ~ species,
                              species == "Rutilus rutilus" ~ species,
                              species == "Clupea harengus" ~ species,
                              species == "Platichthys flesus" ~ species,
                              species == "Neogobius melanostomus" ~ species,
                              TRUE ~ "other"),
         order = case_when(species == "Clupea harengus" ~ 1,
                            species == "Rutilus rutilus" ~ 2,
                            species == "Perca fluviatilis" ~ 3,
                            species == "Neogobius melanostomus" ~ 4,
                            species == "Platichthys flesus" ~ 5,
                            species == "other" ~ 6))%>%
  group_by(season, species)%>%
  reframe(prey_weight_g = sum(prey_weight_g),
          total_biomass_g = total_biomass_g,
          proportion = prey_weight_g/total_biomass_g,
          order = order,
          sample = sample)%>%
  distinct()

fwrite(SC_summary2, "Data/Prey/Stomach_proportions_total.csv")
fwrite(SC_months2, "Data/Prey/Stomach_proportions_months.csv")
fwrite(Prey_energy_species2, "Data/Prey/Energy_content_species.csv")
```

```{r stomach content graphics, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

SC_summary <- fread("Data/Prey/Stomach_proportions_total.csv")
SC_months <- fread("Data/Prey/Stomach_proportions_months.csv")
Prey_energy <- fread("Data/Prey/Energy_content_species.csv")

SC_summary$species <- reorder(SC_summary$species, SC_summary$order)
SC_months$species <- reorder(SC_months$species, SC_months$order)
Prey_energy$species <- reorder(Prey_energy$Species, Prey_energy$order)

Speclabel <- Prey_energy%>%
  group_by(Species)%>%
  transmute(species = Species,
            Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg = 15,
            N = length(species))%>%
  distinct()

SC_summary2 <- SC_summary%>%
  arrange(order)%>%
  mutate(csum = rev(cumsum(rev(proportion2))),
           pos1 = proportion2/2 + lead(csum, 1),
           pos = case_when(is.na(pos1) == TRUE ~ proportion2/2,
                           TRUE ~ pos1))

monthlabel <- SC_months%>%
  group_by(season)%>%
  reframe(season = season,
          sample = sample,
          proportion = 1,
          species = "other")%>%
  distinct()

SC_months$season <- fct_relevel(SC_months$season, "Mar-May", "Jun-Aug", "Sep-Nov", "Dec-Feb")

Props <- ggplot(SC_summary2, aes(x = "", y = proportion2, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +  # Convert to a polar coordinate for pie chart
  labs(title = "prey proportion of total biomass",
       fill = "Species") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(y = pos, label = scales::percent(proportion2)), nudge_x = .75, 
                   size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, fill = "white")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(alpha = 0.9)+
  theme_void()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(-10,-10,-10,-10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5, color = "black", face = "italic"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
        legend.title = element_blank())

months <- ggplot(SC_months[SC_months$season != "Dec-Feb",], aes(x = as.factor(season), y = proportion, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
  geom_text(data = monthlabel[monthlabel$season != "Dec-Feb",], aes(label = paste0("N = ", sample)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 1), size = 2, vjust = 18) +
  labs(x = "season", y = "proportion", title = "prey proportions per season", fill = "Species")+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5, color = "black", face = "italic"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
        legend.title = element_blank())

Energ <- ggplot(Prey_energy, aes(x = species, y = Caloric_value_mJ_per_kg, fill = species))+
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, width = 0.5, lwd = 0.3)+
  labs(title = "species-specific energy content",
       y = "Energy (MJ/kg)",
       fill = "Species")+
  geom_text(data = Speclabel, aes(label = paste0("N = ", N)), 
            position = position_stack(), size = 2, vjust = -.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(15, 26.1),
                     breaks = seq(15, 25, 1))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d()+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5, color = "black", face = "italic"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 10),
        legend.title = element_blank())

Pies <- ggarrange(Props, months, Energ, common.legend = T, legend = "bottom",
                  labels = c("A", "B", "C"), vjust = .5, ncol = 1)+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10,1,1,1))

ggsave("Figures/Stomach-contents-all_months.png", Pies, width = 8, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

# SI Cleanup

```{r pike muscle data cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read in pike data from source
Pike1 <- read.delim("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt", 
                    sep = ";", dec = ".", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

Pike2 <- Pike1%>%
  filter(MarkorRecap == "Mark"|is.na(MarkorRecap) == TRUE|Fish_ID == "BH-51614")%>%
  transmute(ID=case_when(Fish_ID=="BH-91050.2"~"BH-91050",
                         Fish_ID=="BH-51614"&Waterbody=="BAT"~"NA",
                         TRUE~Fish_ID),
            capt_date=Date,
            TL_mm = Total_Length_mm,
            weight=Weight,
            sex=Sex,
            area=case_when(ID == "BH-00554" ~ "Peene",
                           ID == "BH-00555" ~ "Peene",
                           TRUE ~ Waterbody),
            Long=case_when(is.na(Capture_Longitude)==T~Release_Longitude,
                           TRUE~Capture_Longitude),
            Lat=case_when(is.na(Capture_Latitude)==T~Release_Latitude,
                          TRUE~Capture_Latitude))

#Read pike SI data
pike_NCS1 <- read.csv2("Data/Pike/2022-09-08_NCS_Pike.CSV", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

pike_NCS2 <- pike_NCS1%>%
  transmute(ID=substr(Identifier.1, 1,8),
            ID2=substr(Identifier.1,9,10),
            Sample="Muscle",
            d15N=as.numeric(d.15N.14N.Calculated),
            d13C=as.numeric(d.13C.12C.Calculated),
            d34S=as.numeric(d.34S.32S.Calculated),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(C..)/as.numeric(N..),
            comment=paste(Comment.1,"|",Comment.2))%>%
  filter(!grepl("Measurement repeated", comment)|ID=="BH-00380"|ID=="BH-00829")

Mixed <- read.delim("Data/Pike/2021-02 Boddenhecht Timo Rittweg TG.txt")

Mixed2 <- Mixed%>%
  transmute(ID=ID2,
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=ID1,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N..permil.N2.atm.),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C..permil.VPDB.),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S..permil.CDT.),
            CN_ratio=as.numeric(weight.C)/as.numeric(weight.N),
            comment=NA)%>%
  filter(Sample!="Eyelens")

pike_NCS2 <- rbind(pike_NCS2, Mixed2)

pike_NCS3 <- fread("Data/Pike/2023-04-21_NCS_Pike.CSV")

pike_NCS4 <- pike_NCS3%>%
  transmute(ID=case_when(Identifier.1 == "BH-71000" ~ "BH-51614",
                         TRUE ~ Identifier.1),
            ID2=NA,
            Sample=Identifier.2,
            d15N=as.numeric(d15N),
            d13C=as.numeric(d13C),
            d34S=as.numeric(d34S),
            CN_ratio=(Amount.ug*(Cperc/100))/(Amount.ug*(Nperc/100)),
            comment=Comment)%>%
  filter(Sample!="eye lens")

pike_NCSall <- rbind(pike_NCS2, pike_NCS4)

pike_NCSall2 <- pike_NCSall%>%filter(Sample == "Muscle"|Sample == "muscle")%>%
  drop_na(d34S)%>%
  distinct()

#Join pike data
length(unique(pike_NCSall2$ID))

Pikedata <- Pike2%>%
  inner_join(pike_NCSall2,by="ID")

length(unique(Pikedata$ID))

#check missing fish (remove from final file before submission)
pikeSIall <- data.frame(ID = unique(pike_NCSall2$ID))
pikeSIDall <- data.frame(ID = unique(Pikedata$ID), Database = "TRUE")

Pikecheck <- pikeSIall%>%
  left_join(pikeSIDall, by = "ID")

i <- "BH-00554"
Pike2[Pike2$ID == i,]
Pike1[Pike1$Fish_ID == i,]
pike_NCS2[pike_NCS2$ID == i,]
pike_NCS4[pike_NCS4$ID == i,]
pike_NCSall2[pike_NCSall2$ID == i,]

#check whether "A" (biopsy with idoine as disinfectant) and "B" (no iodine) are different
Iodinecheck <- subset(Pikedata, ID2 == "A"|ID2 == "B")

#simple t.test
with(Iodinecheck, t.test(d15N[ID2 == "A"], d15N[ID2 == "B"]))
with(Iodinecheck, t.test(d13C[ID2 == "A"], d13C[ID2 == "B"]))
with(Iodinecheck, t.test(d34S[ID2 == "A"], d34S[ID2 == "B"]))

#average SI values
pikedata2 <- Pikedata%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::reframe(ID=ID,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight,
            sex=sex,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            Sample_type=case_when(Sample == "Muscle" ~ "muscle",
                                  TRUE ~ Sample),
            d15N=mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
            d13C=mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
            d34S=mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
            CN_ratio=mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T))%>%
  distinct()

length(unique(pikedata2$ID))

#Lipid correction

ggplot(data=pikedata2, aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

dep <-  pikedata2
dep$rcn <- with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L <- with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C, na.rm = T);sd(dep$d13C, na.rm = T)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

pikedata3 <- dep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species="E.lucius",
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            sample_type=Sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13Cc,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio)

fwrite(pikedata3, "Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
```

```{r join phenotype data with CNS data, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#read pike SI values
pikeSI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")

#Join otolith phenotypes with SI data
#read otolith phenotype data
Otopike <- read.delim("Data/Pike/Pikedata_ecotypes.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

Otopike.SI <- Otopike%>%left_join(pikeSI, by="ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            TL_mm=TL_mm.x,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex.x,
            study_area=waterbody,
            waterbody=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            inc_um=inc_um,
            res_mean=res_mean,
            Sr_mean=Sr_mean,
            SI_sample=sample_type,
            ecotype=ecotype,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio)

length(unique(Otopike.SI[is.na(Otopike.SI$d34S)==F,]$ID))
length(unique(Otopike.SI$ID))

#Reformat Otopike
Otopike2 <- Otopike.SI%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            capt_date = capt_date,
            TL_mm = TL_mm,
            weight_g = weight_g,
            sex = sex,
            area = study_area,
            Long = Long,
            Lat = Lat,
            ecotype = case_when(ecotype == "FW_resident" ~ "FW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Trans-habitat" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                TRUE ~ ecotype),
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  drop_na(d34S)%>%
  distinct()

#read telemetry phenotypes
Telepike <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata_telemetry_types.txt")

#Reformat telepike
Telepike2 <- Telepike%>%
  filter(diag != "nodata" & ID != "BH-90307")%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            ecotype = last(diag),
            area = Area)%>%
  distinct()
  
#Join telemetry phenotypes with SI data
TeleSI <- pikeSI%>%
  inner_join(Telepike2, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID = ID,
            capt_date = capt_date,
            TL_mm = TL_mm,
            weight_g = weight_g,
            sex = sex,
            area = case_when(area.x == "Peene" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "U" ~ "NA",
                             area.x == "Sehrowbach" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Barthe" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Beek" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Duwenbeek" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "NHG" ~ "Tributary",
                             area.x == "Ziese" ~ "Tributary",
                             TRUE ~ area.x),
            Long = Long,
            Lat = Lat,
            ecotype = case_when(ecotype == "Brackish" ~ "BW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Fresh" ~ "FW-resident",
                                ecotype == "Ubergangs II" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                ecotype == "Ubergangs I" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                ecotype == "Anadrom" ~ "Anadromous"),
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  distinct()

#Ecotypes
Ecotypes_SI <- rbind(Otopike2, TeleSI)

duplicates <- Ecotypes_SI[duplicated(Ecotypes_SI$ID) | duplicated(Ecotypes_SI$ID, fromLast = TRUE), ]

fwrite(Ecotypes_SI, "Data/Pike/Ecotypes-Oto-Tele_SI_clean.csv")
```

```{r pike eye lens data cleanup, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
  return(max_layer - (layer_vector - min(layer_vector)))
```

```{r marry lens data to otoliths, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#load lens data with length
Lensdata <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-SI-all-clean-TL-backcalculated.csv")

#load otolith data
Pikeoto <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata_model.csv")

Pikeoto <- as.data.frame(Pikeoto)
Pikeoto$ID <- as.factor(Pikeoto$ID)

Pikeoto2 <- Pikeoto%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(trad_um = max(rad_um))

#Backcalculate lengths
ggplot(Pikeoto2, aes(x = TL_mm, y = trad_um))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

otomod <- lm(TL_mm~trad_um, data = Pikeoto2)
summary(otomod)

a <- coefficients(otomod)[[1]]
#Model not needed, as otoliths form at birth!

Pikeoto3 <- Pikeoto2%>%
  dplyr::mutate(length_back = (rad_um/trad_um)*(TL_mm))

ALK <- Pikeoto3%>%
  transmute(fish_ID = ID,
            lifeyear = lifeyear,
            length_back = length_back)%>%
  distinct()

#Marry to eye lens layers
Pikelenses <- as.data.frame(Lensdata)
ALK <- as.data.frame(ALK)

#Filter out non-Oto fish
IDlist <- unique(ALK$ID)

Pikelenses <- Pikelenses%>%
  filter(fish_ID %in% IDlist)%>%
  drop_na(Length_back)


IDOto <- unique(Pikelenses$fish_ID)
age <- NULL
ages <- NULL

for (i in 1:length(IDOto)) {
  age <- ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 1), "length_back"], 1,
                 ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 2), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 1), "length_back"], 2,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 3), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 2), "length_back"], 3,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 4), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 3), "length_back"], 4,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 5), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 4), "length_back"], 5,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 6), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 5), "length_back"], 6,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 7), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 6), "length_back"], 7,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 8), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 7), "length_back"], 8,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 9), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 8), "length_back"], 9,
                   ifelse(Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] <= 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 10), "length_back"] & 
                     Pikelenses[which(Pikelenses$fish_ID == IDOto[i]), "Length_back"] > 
                   ALK[which(ALK$ID == IDOto[i] & ALK$lifeyear == 9), "length_back"], 10, NA))))))))))
  ages <- na.omit(c(ages, age))
}

Pikelenses$age <- ages

#Reshape, correct one fish that was assigned "NA" for some reason (1 year old, so only one lifeyear to assign)
Pikelenses_age <- Pikelenses%>%
  transmute(ID = fish_ID,
            lifeyear = case_when(ID == "BH-01719" ~ 1,
                                 TRUE ~ age),
            amount = amount,
            d15N = d15N,
            d13C = d13C,
            d34S = d34S,
            CN_ratio = CN_ratio)%>%
  distinct()

length(unique(Pikelenses_age$ID))

Pike_oto_lenses <- Pikeoto3%>%
  inner_join(Pikelenses_age, by = c("ID", "lifeyear"))

length(unique(Pike_oto_lenses$ID))

#reformat, change the fish that were identified as anadromous using the decision framework in Rittweg et al., (2024)
Pikedata_model <- Pike_oto_lenses%>%
  group_by(ID, lifeyear)%>%
  dplyr::reframe(ID = ID,
                   waterbody = waterbody,
                   TL_mm = TL_mm,
                   phenotype = case_when(ID == "BH-01904"|ID == "BH-01903"|ID == "BH-00750" ~ "Anadromous",
                                         phenotype == "FW_resident" ~ "FW-resident",
                                         phenotype == "Trans-habitat" ~ "Cross-habitat",
                                         TRUE ~ phenotype),
                   sex = sex,
                   lifeyear = lifeyear,
                   res_mean = res_mean,
                   Sr_mean = Sr_mean,
                   genotype = genotype,
                   length_back = length_back,
                   d15N_mean = mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
                   d13C_mean = mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
                   d34S_mean = mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
                   CN_mean = mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T))%>%
  distinct()

length(unique(Pikedata_model$ID))

fwrite(Pikedata_model, "Data/Pike/Pikedata-eye-lens-years.csv")
```

```{r prey fish data, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
IDcheck <- preySID%>%left_join(preySID2, by="ID")

#Average SI values
prey_NCSall <- prey_NCSall%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  reframe(ID=ID,
            Sample=Sample,
            d15N=mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
            d13C=mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
            d34S=mean(d34S, na.rm = T),
            CN_ratio=mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = T),
            comment=comment)%>%
  distinct()

#join with preyfish data

Prey <- Prey2%>%inner_join(prey_NCSall, by="ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=case_when(Species=="Herring"~"C.harengus",
                              Species=="C. harengus"~"C.harengus",
                              Species=="Roach"~"R.rutilus",
                              Species=="R.rutilus"~"R.rutilus",
                              Species=="R. rutilus"~"R.rutilus",
                              Species=="Round goby"~"N.melanostomus",
                              Species=="N. melanostomus"~"N.melanostomus",
                              Species=="Tench"~"T.tinca",
                              Species=="T. tinca"~"T.tinca",
                              Species=="Bleak"~"A.alburnus",
                              Species=="A. alburnus"~"A.alburnus",
                              Species=="Perch"~"P.fluviatilis",
                              Species=="P. fluviatilis"~"P.fluviatilis",
                              Species=="Pikeperch"~"S.lucioperca",
                              Species=="Silver bream"~"B.bjoerkna",
                              Species=="B. bjoerkna"~"B.bjoerkna",
                              Species=="White bream"~"B.bjoerkna",
                              Species=="Vimba bream"~"V.vimba",
                              Species=="P. spec"~"P.spec",
                              Species=="P.microps"~"P.spec",
                              Species=="G. aculeatus"~"G.aculeatus",
                              Species=="Three-spined stickleback"~"G.aculeatus",
                              Species=="S. erythrophthalmus"~"S.erythrophthalmus",
                              Species=="Rudd"~"S.erythrophthalmus",
                              Species=="G. cernua"~"G.cernua",
                              Species=="Flounder"~"P.flesus",
                              Species=="P. flesus"~"P.flesus",
                              Species=="Plaice"~"P.platessa",
                              Species=="Eel"~"A.anguilla",
                              Species=="A. anguilla"~"A.anguilla",
                              Species=="Pike"~"NA",
                              Species=="Nine-spined stickleback"~"P.pungitius",
                              Species=="Cod"~"G.morhua",
                              Species=="A.tobianus"~"A.tobianus",
                              Species=="S. spratus"~"S.sprattus",
                              Species=="Salmo trutta  t."~"S.trutta",
                              Species=="Z. viviparus"~"Z.viviparus"),
            capt_date=capt_date,
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment.x,
            comment2=comment.y)


#check missing fish
preySID <- data.frame(ID=unique(prey_NCSall$ID))

preyID <- data.frame(ID=unique(Prey$ID),
                     ID2=unique(Prey$ID))

IDcheck <- preySID%>%left_join(preyID, by="ID")

#lipid corrections
ggplot(data=Prey[Prey$Species=="C.harengus"|Prey$Species=="P.fluviatilis"|Prey$Species=="R.rutilus"|
                   Prey$Species=="P.flesus"|Prey$Species=="N.melanostomus",], aes(x=CN_ratio, y=d13C))+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Species~., scales="free_y")+
  theme_bw()

#Lipid correction for d13C depending on the C:N,  for values >3.5 (as recommended by Skinner et al 2016)
dep = subset(Prey, Species%in%c("C.harengus", "P.flesus","P.fluviatilis","R.rutilus","N.melanostomus"))
dep$rcn=with(dep, CN_ratio)
dep$L<-with(dep,-20.54+7.24*rcn)
 
mean(dep$d13C);sd(dep$d13C)
mean(dep$rcn);sd(dep$rcn)

# Fishes Kiljunen et al.(2006) # Carefull, this correction is not adequate for invertebrates!!!
dep$d13Cc<-with(dep,ifelse(rcn>3.5, d13C+7.018*(0.048+3.9/(1+287/L)),d13C))

depdep2 <- dep%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=Species,
            capt_date=capt_date,
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13Cc,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment1,
            comment2=comment2)

C.corrected <- rbind(Prey[!Prey$Species%in%c("C.harengus", "P.flesus","P.fluviatilis","R.rutilus","N.melanostomus"),],depdep2)

fwrite(C.corrected, "Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
```

```{r biplots whole sample, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
Prey <- fread("Data/Prey/Preyfish_SI_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")
```

```{r mixing models ecotypes, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Telepike$ID <- Telepike$id

Prey$SL_mm <- as.numeric(Prey$SL_mm)

Prey1 <- Prey%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species=Species,
            group=case_when(area=="Barthe"~"freshwater",
                            area=="Ziese"~"freshwater",
                            area!="Barthe"&area!="Ziese"&Species=="R.rutilus"~"lagoon",
                            Species=="C.harengus"~"marine",
                            Species=="P.flesus"~"marine",
                            area!="Barthe"&area!="Ziese"&Species=="P.fluviatilis"~"lagoon",
                            Species=="N.melanostomus"~"lagoon",
                            TRUE~"Other"),
            SL_mm=SL_mm,
            SL_size_class=SL_size_class,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            height_mm=height_mm,
            sample_type=sample_type,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            comment1=comment1,
            comment2=comment2)%>%
  filter(group!="Other")

Pike2 <- Pike%>%
  filter(TL_mm <= 1000)%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            Species="E.lucius",
            capt_date=as.character(capt_date),
            Length=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            area=area,
            ecotype=ecotype,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio)%>%
  mutate(halflife = exp(0.22*log(weight_g)+3.28))%>%
  filter(area!="KD"&area!="U")%>%
  drop_na(d15N,d13C,d34S,Length,area)%>%
  distinct()
```

```{r graphic mixing models overview simple, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

# Create diagnostics, summary statistics, and posterior plots
jags.pike <- readRDS("Data/Mixing models/Output/Mixing.model-normal-run-ecotype_TL.rds")

Pike2 <- fread("Data/Mixing models/Pikemix-ecotypes.csv")

source.filename <- "Data/Mixing models/Sources.csv"
mix.filename <- "Data/Mixing models/Pikemix-ecotypes_all.csv"

# Load mixture data
mix <- load_mix_data(filename=mix.filename, 
                     iso_names=c("d15N", "d13C", "d34S"),
                     factors="ecotype",
                     fac_random=FALSE,
                     fac_nested=FALSE,
                     cont_effects="Length")

# Load source data
source<- load_source_data(filename=source.filename, source_factors=NULL,
                          conc_dep=FALSE, data_type="means", mix)

global.contrib.p <- data.frame(median = jags.pike$BUGSoutput$median$p.fac1, ecotype=c("anadromous",
                                                                                      "brackish resident",
                                                                                      "cross-habitat",
                                                                                      "freshwater resident"))
global.contrib.sd <- data.frame(sd = jags.pike$BUGSoutput$sd$p.fac1,
                                ecotype=c("anadromous",
                                          "brackish resident",
                                          "cross-habitat",
                                          "freshwater resident"))

names(global.contrib.p) <- c(paste0("p.", source[["source_names"]]),"ecotype")
names(global.contrib.sd) <- c(paste0("sd.", source[["source_names"]]),"ecotype")

sum <- rowSums(global.contrib.p[,1:3])

global.contrib.p2 <- global.contrib.p%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = p.freshwater:p.marine,names_to = "species", values_to = "median")%>%
  transmute(ecotype=fct_relevel(ecotype,
                                "freshwater resident",
                                "anadromous",
                                "cross-habitat",
                                "brackish resident"),
            species=sub("p.","",species),
            median=median)
global.contrib.sd2 <- global.contrib.sd%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = sd.freshwater:sd.marine,names_to = "species", values_to = "sd")%>%
  transmute(ecotype=fct_relevel(ecotype,
                                "freshwater resident",
                                "anadromous",
                                "cross-habitat",
                                "brackish resident"),
            species=sub("sd.","",species),
            sd=sd)

global.contrib2 <- global.contrib.p2%>%inner_join(global.contrib.sd2, by = c("species", "ecotype"))


indiv.contrib <- data.frame(contr=jags.pike$BUGSoutput$mean$p.ind)
indiv.sd <- data.frame(sd=jags.pike$BUGSoutput$sd$p.ind)
names(indiv.contrib) <- paste0("p.",source[["source_names"]])
names(indiv.sd) <- paste0("sd.",source[["source_names"]])
indiv.contrib$ID <- Pike2$ID
indiv.sd$ID <- Pike2$ID

contrib.pike <- indiv.contrib%>%
  inner_join(indiv.sd, by = "ID")

Pike.contrib <- Pike2 %>%
  inner_join(contrib.pike, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            capt_date,
            TL_mm = Length,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            area=area,
            Long=Long,
            Lat=Lat,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,

            CN_ratio=CN_ratio,
            halflife=halflife,
            p.marine=p.marine,
            sd.marine=sd.marine,
            p.lagoon=p.lagoon,
            sd.lagoon=sd.lagoon,
            p.freshwater=p.freshwater,
            sd.freshwater=sd.freshwater)

fwrite(Pike.contrib, "Data/Mixing models/Pike_individual_diet.csv")

pl.theme <- theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(),
                  legend.background = element_blank(),
                  legend.box.background = element_blank(),
                  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black", linetype = 1),
                  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black"),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
                  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
                  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
                  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
                  legend.key.size = unit(.8,"line"),
                  plot.title = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

Pike.length <- ggplot(Pike.contrib)+
  geom_smooth(aes(TL_mm, p.marine, color="marine", fill="marine"))+
  geom_smooth(aes(TL_mm, p.freshwater, color="freshwater", fill="freshwater"))+

                     breaks = c("marine", "lagoon", "freshwater"),

                     labels = c("marine food web", "lagoon food web", "freshwater food web"))+
  scale_fill_manual(name = "energy source",
                     breaks = c("marine", "lagoon", "freshwater"),
                     values = c("#29B6F6", "#00796B","#B71C1C"),
                     labels = c("marine food web", "lagoon food web", "freshwater food web"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                     breaks = c(0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1), labels = c("0", "25", "50", "75", "100"))+

ggsave("Figures/diet-per-length_global.png", Pike.length, width = 15, height = 9, units = "cm", dpi = 600)
```

```{r GLMMs age-specific growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Data <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-eye-lens-years.csv")

Data2 <- Data%>%
  drop_na(d34S_mean)%>%
  group_by(ID)%>%
  reframe(ID = ID,
          lifeyear = lifeyear,
          waterbody = as.factor(waterbody),
          phenotype = phenotype,
          genotype = genotype,
          sex = sex,
          length_back = case_when(lifeyear > 1 ~ length_back-lag(length_back),
                                  TRUE ~ length_back),
          d13C = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d13C_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d13C_mean-(mean(Data$d13C_mean)))),
          d15N = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d15N_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d15N_mean-(mean(Data$d15N_mean)))),
          d34S = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(d34S_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (d34S_mean-(mean(Data$d34S_mean, na.rm = T)))),
          CN = case_when(max(lifeyear) != 1 ~ scale(CN_mean, center = T, scale = T),
                           TRUE ~ (CN_mean-(mean(Data$CN_mean)))))%>%
  filter(length_back < 700)

length(unique(Data2$ID))

fwrite(Data2, "Data/Pike/Pikedata-model.csv")

pikemodel1 <- lmer(length_back~I(lifeyear^2)+sex+d13C+d15N+d34S+(1|ID), data = Data2, REML = T)

pike.vif <- vif(pikemodel1)

barplot(pike.vif, main = "VIF values", horiz = F, col = "darkgreen", ylim = c(0,10),
        las = 2)
abline(h = 5, lwd = 3, lty = 2, col="red")

#test effects
rand(pikemodel1)
#Individual is not significant

#Test age effect
pikemodel_noage <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -I(lifeyear^2))
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_noage)

#Test sex effect
pikemodel_nosex <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -sex)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_nosex)

#Test d13C
pikemodel_no13C <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d13C)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no13C)

#Test d15N
pikemodel_no15N <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d15N)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no15N)

#test d34S
pikemodel_no34S <- update(pikemodel1, ~. -d34S)
anova(pikemodel1, pikemodel_no34S)

r.squaredGLMM(pikemodel1)
summary(pikemodel1)
tab_model(pikemodel1)
```

```{r model eval, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
Data2 <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-model.csv")

pikemodel1 <- lmer(length_back~I(lifeyear^2)+sex+phenotype+d13C+d15N+d34S+(1|ID), data = Data2, REML = T)

pike.vif <- vif(pikemodel1)

png("Figures/supplement/VIF-values-mixed-effects.png", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", res = 300)
barplot(pike.vif, main = "VIF values", horiz = F, col = "darkgreen", ylim = c(0,10),
        las = 2)
abline(h = 5, lwd = 3, lty = 2, col="red")
dev.off()

Data3 <- Data2 %>% drop_na()
Data3$resid <- resid(pikemodel1)

png("Figures/supplement/Fitted-vs-residual_mixed-effects.png", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", res = 300)
plot(pikemodel1, xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")
dev.off()

png("Figures/supplement/Residual-distribution_mixed-effects.png", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", res = 300)
hist(Data3$resid, main = "", xlab = "Residuals")
dev.off()

png("Figures/supplement/Normality-residuals_mixed-effects.png", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", res = 300)
qqnorm(resid(pikemodel1))
qqline(resid(pikemodel1))
dev.off()

png("Figures/supplement/Residuals-vs-predictors_mixed-effects.png", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm", res = 300)
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(Data3$resid~as.factor(Data3$sex), ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Sex")
plot(Data3$resid~Data3$lifeyear, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Age")
plot(Data3$resid~Data3$d15N, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d15N")
plot(Data3$resid~Data3$d13C, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d13C")
plot(Data3$resid~Data3$d34S, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d34S")
plot(Data3$resid~Data3$CN, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "C:N ratio")
dev.off()
```

```{r GLMM model figures, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

pikes <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-model.csv")

pikes <- pikes%>%
  reframe(ID = ID,
          lifeyear = lifeyear,
          waterbody = as.factor(waterbody),
          phenotype = phenotype,
          genotype = genotype,
          sex = sex,
          length_back = length_back,
          d13C = d13C,
          d15N = d15N,
          d34S = d34S,
          CN = CN)%>%
  filter(length_back < 700)

#factorize age
pikes$agefact <- ifelse(pikes$lifeyear==1, 2, 
                         ifelse(pikes$lifeyear==2, 1,
                                ifelse(pikes$lifeyear>2, 3, NA)))

pikes$agefact2 <- factor(pikes$agefact,levels = c(2,1,3),
                                            labels = c("0-1 years", "1-2 years", 
                                                       "> 2 years"))

mypallette <- viridis::viridis(4, direction = -1)

#Isotope effects growth
d34S <- ggplot(pikes, aes(d34S,log(length_back)))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2,2))+
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,500),
                     #breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250))+
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", fill="#440154FF", color = "#FDE725FF", fullrange = T, lwd=.8)+
  labs(x=expression("scaled"~delta^34*"S"~("z-score")), 
       y="yearly growth increment (mm)")+
  scale_color_viridis_d()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(),
        legend.position = c(.9,.82),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black", linetype = 1),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .5, colour = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t=15), colour = "black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t=30), colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(.8,"line"))

ggsave("Figures/Iso-effect-growth.png", d34S, width = 15, height = 9, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r population niches whole population level, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Ecopike <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-muscle-SI-eco-clean-cbackcalculated.csv")

Ecopike <- as.data.frame(Ecopike)
Ecopike2 <- Ecopike%>%
  drop_na(diameter_mm)
Ecopike2$fish_ID <- factor(Ecopike2$fish_ID)

#multi-response model population-level
mod1 <- MCMCglmm(cbind(d13C, d15N, d34S)~trait-1, random = ~fish_ID, data = Ecopike2, family = c("gaussian", "gaussian", "gaussian"), 
                 rcov = ~us(trait):units, pr = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, nitt = 100000, burnin = 50000, thin = 50)

#Extract between individual component model 1
BICmat <- mod1$VCV[, "fish_ID"]
BIC <- mean(BICmat)

#Extract within individual component model 1
WICmat <- mod1$VCV[, grep("trait", colnames(mod1$VCV))]

#Convert whole population residual variance into matrix
CC <- mean(WICmat[,1])
NC <- mean(WICmat[,2])
SC <- mean(WICmat[,3])
CN <- mean(WICmat[,4])
NN <- mean(WICmat[,5])
SN <- mean(WICmat[,6])
CS <- mean(WICmat[,7])
NS <- mean(WICmat[,8])
SS <- mean(WICmat[,9])

WICmat <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)

#fill diagonals with residual variance
WICmat[1,1] <- CC
WICmat[2,2] <- NN
WICmat[3,3] <- SS

#fill off-diagonals with residual covariance
WICmat[1,2] <- CN
WICmat[1,3] <- CS
WICmat[2,1] <- NC
WICmat[2,3] <- NS
WICmat[3,1] <- SC
WICmat[3,2] <- SN

row.names(WICmat) <- c("C", "N", "S")
colnames(WICmat) <- c("C", "N", "S")

TNWmat <- BIC + WICmat

mean(eigen(WICmat)$value/eigen(TNWmat)$value)

write.table(TNWmat, "Data/Pike/Total-niche-width_matrix.txt")
write.table(WICmat, "Data/Pike/Within-individual-variance_matrix.txt")
```

```{r individual niche width, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
mod1 <- readRDS("Data/Pike/Variance-components.rds")
Ecopike2 <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-SI-eco-clean-cbackcalculated.csv")
TNWmat <- read.table("Data/Pike/Total-niche-width_matrix.txt")
WICmat <- read.table("Data/Pike/Within-individual-variance_matrix.txt")

#Individual covariance matrices
# Initialize an empty list to store covariance matrices from raw data
num_fish <- length(unique(Ecopike2$fish_ID))
raw_cov_matrices_list <- vector("list", length = num_fish)

# Loop through each fish_ID and calculate the covariance matrices from raw data
for (i in 1:num_fish) {
  fish_data <- subset(Ecopike2, fish_ID == unique(Ecopike2$fish_ID)[i])
  raw_cov_matrix <- cov(fish_data[, c("d13C", "d15N", "d34S")], use = "complete.obs")
  raw_cov_matrices_list[[i]] <- raw_cov_matrix
}

names(raw_cov_matrices_list) <- unique(Ecopike2$fish_ID)

saveRDS(raw_cov_matrices_list, file = "Data/Pike/individual-varcov-CNS.RData")
raw_cov_matrices_list["BH-01922"]
# Function to calculate normalized eigenvalues
eigenval <- function(fish_matrix, population_matrix) {
  if (any(is.na(fish_matrix))) {
    return(NA)
  }
  eigenvalues_fish <- eigen(fish_matrix)$values
  if (any(is.na(eigenvalues_fish))) {
    return(NA)
  }
  #population matrix
  eigenvalues_population <- eigen(population_matrix)$values
  normalized_eigenvalues <- eigenvalues_fish / eigenvalues_population
  return(mean(normalized_eigenvalues))
}

# Initialize an empty list to store results
normalized_eigenvalues_list <- numeric(num_fish)

for (i in 1:num_fish) {
  fish_matrix <- raw_cov_matrices_list[[i]]  # Use the raw data covariance matrix
  normalized_eigenvalues_list[i] <- eigenval(fish_matrix, TNWmat)
}

Spec_index <- tibble(fish_ID = unique(Ecopike2$fish_ID), s_index = normalized_eigenvalues_list)

Ecopike_spec <- Ecopike2%>%
  left_join(Spec_index, by = "fish_ID")%>%
  mutate(phenotype = fct_relevel(phenotype,
                                 "FW_resident",
                                 "Anadromous", 
                                 "Trans-habitat",
                                 "BW-resident"))

fwrite(Ecopike_spec, "Data/Pike/Pike_eco-clean-cbackcalculated_s-metric.csv")
```

```{r individual niche width phenotype level, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
}

for (i in 1:num_fish_Cross) {

  raw_cov_matrix <- cov(fish_data[, c("d13C", "d15N", "d34S")], use = "complete.obs")

}

  raw_cov_matrix <- cov(fish_data[, c("d13C", "d15N", "d34S")], use = "complete.obs")
  raw_cov_matrices_list_BW[[i]] <- raw_cov_matrix
}

eigenval <- function(fish_matrix, population_matrix) {
  if (any(is.na(fish_matrix))) {
    return(NA)
  }
  eigenvalues_fish <- eigen(fish_matrix)$values
  if (any(is.na(eigenvalues_fish))) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
#population matrix
  eigenvalues_population <- eigen(population_matrix)$values
  normalized_eigenvalues <- eigenvalues_fish / eigenvalues_population
  return(mean(normalized_eigenvalues))
}
```

```{r phenotype overlap, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Ecopike <- fread("Data/Pike/Lens-muscle-SI-eco-clean-cbackcalculated.csv")
source("funcs.R")

thedata <- Ecopike%>%
  transmute(groups = phenotype,
            isotope1 = d13C,
            isotope2 = d15N,
            isotope3 = d34S)%>%
  arrange(groups)%>%
  drop_na(isotope1, isotope2, isotope3)

thedata <- as.data.frame(thedata)

sink("ellipsoid_pheno.txt")
cat("
model{
  
  #priors
    for (k in 1:ngroups){
    mu[k,1] ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
    mu[k,2] ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
    mu[k,3] ~ dnorm(0,0.001)
    prec[1:3,1:3,k] ~ dwish(S3,4)
    cov[1:3,1:3,k] <- inverse(prec[1:3,1:3,k])
    #likelihood
    for (i in 1:maxn){
    y[i,1:3,k] ~ dmnorm(mu[k,],prec[,,k])
    }#i
    }
    }
    
    
    ",fill = TRUE)
sink()

#generate list names of each group
groupnames <- levels(as.factor(thedata[,1]))

#generate list of isotope names and number of isotopes
isotope_names <- colnames(thedata)[2:4]
isotopes<-3

#convert group names to numeric factors
thedata[,1] <- as.numeric(as.factor(thedata[,1]))
ngroups <- max(thedata[,1])

#find the groups with the largest n and the n per group
nstart <- c(NA)
nend <- c(NA)
for (i in 1:ngroups){
nstart[i] <- min(as.numeric(rownames(thedata[thedata[,1]==i,])))
nend[i] <- max(as.numeric(rownames(thedata[thedata[,1]==i,])))
}
maxn <- max(nend+1-nstart)
npergroup <- nend+1-nstart

# create an array where nrow = the n of the largest group, for groups with smaller n's 
# some rows will have NA's to account for uneven replication

y <- array(NA,dim = c(maxn,3,ngroups), dimnames = list(NULL,isotope_names,groupnames))
for (i in 1:ngroups){
  y[1:nrow(thedata[thedata[,1]==i,2:4]),,i] <- as.matrix(thedata[thedata[,1]==i,2:4])
}
#ensure y is a completely numeric array
y <- array(as.numeric(y),dim = dim(y))

#objects passed to jags
data = list(y = y,ngroups = ngroups, maxn = maxn, S3 = (diag(3)*3))
  
#initial values
mu0 <- matrix(NA, nrow = ngroups, ncol=3)
prec0 <- array(0,dim = c(3,3,ngroups))
for (k in 1:ngroups){
mu0[k,] <- mvrnorm(1,c(0,0,0),diag(3)*100)
prec0[,,k] <- getcov(runif(1,5,30))
}
inits = function(){list( mu = mu0, prec = prec0)}

# parameters to monitor
params <- c("mu","cov")

# MCMC settings
nt <- 50
nb <- 1000
nc <- 3
na<-1000
ni <- 5000 



out <- jagsUI::jags(data = data,
            inits = inits,
            parameters.to.save = params,
            model.file = 'ellipsoid_pheno.txt',
            n.chains = nc,
            n.iter = ni,
            n.adapt = 1000,
            n.burnin = nb,
            n.thin = nt)

#plot(out)
summary(out,digits=2)

# a list to index pairwise comparisons
pl <- cbind(sort(rep(seq(1:ngroups),ngroups)),rep(seq(1:ngroups),ngroups))
# probabilities to posterior distrobutions
probs <- c(0.025,0.5,0.975)
# Calculate an estimate of SEV from each posterior estimate of sigma and summarize
SEV <- matrix(NA,ncol = ngroups,nrow = nrow(out$sims.list$cov))
SEV.summary <- matrix(NA,nrow = ngroups,ncol = 3+length(probs))

for (k in 1:ngroups){
  SEV[,k] <- apply(out$sims.list$cov[,,,k],1,SEV.function)
  SEV.summary[k,] <- c(nend[k]+1-nstart[k],quantile(SEV[,k],probs=probs),mode(SEV[,k]), mean(SEV[,k]))
}
rownames(SEV.summary) <- groupnames
colnames(SEV.summary) <- c("n",paste(probs,"%",sep=""),"mode","mean")

#Compare each posterior SEV estimate to those of other groups
SEV.diff <- array(NA,dim = c(ngroups,ngroups,nrow(SEV)))
for(i in 1:(ngroups*ngroups)){
  SEV.diff[pl[i,1],pl[i,2],] <- SEV[,pl[i,1]]-SEV[,pl[i,2]]
}
p.table <- matrix(NA,nrow = ngroups,ncol = ngroups)
colnames(p.table) <- paste(">",groupnames, sep="")
rownames(p.table) <- groupnames
for (i in 1:(ngroups*ngroups)){
    p.table[pl[i,1],pl[i,2]] <- sum(SEV.diff[pl[i,1],pl[i,2],]>0)/nrow(SEV)
}

# define objects for mu and sigma values from the posterior
mus <- out$sims.list$mu
sigmas <- out$sims.list$cov

#create a matrix of all pair-wise comparisons
pairs <- pairwise(ngroups)

overlap <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mus), ncol = nrow(pairs))
overlap.SEV <- array(1, dim = c(ngroups,ngroups,nrow(mus)))
for(i in 1:nrow(pairs)){
  for(j in 1:nrow(mus)){
    overlap[j,i] <- CubeCount3D(mus[j,pairs[i,1],],
                                mus[j,pairs[i,2],],
                                sigmas[j,,,pairs[i,1]],
                                sigmas[j,,,pairs[i,2]])
  }
  overlap.SEV[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2],] <- overlap[,i]/SEV[,pairs[i,1]]
  overlap.SEV[pairs[i,2],pairs[i,1],] <- overlap[,i]/SEV[,pairs[i,2]]
}

#summarize results
overlap.2.5<-matrix(NA, nrow=ngroups, ncol=ngroups)
overlap.40<-matrix(NA, nrow=ngroups, ncol=ngroups)
overlap.975<-matrix(NA, nrow=ngroups, ncol=ngroups)

for (i in 1:nrow(pairs)){
    overlap.2.5[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2]]<-quantile(overlap.SEV[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2],], probs=0.025)
    overlap.40[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2]]<-quantile(overlap.SEV[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2],], probs=0.4)
    overlap.975[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2]]<-quantile(overlap.SEV[pairs[i,1],pairs[i,2],], probs=0.75)
  }

rownames(overlap.2.5) <- groupnames
colnames(overlap.2.5) <- groupnames
rownames(overlap.40) <- groupnames
colnames(overlap.40) <- groupnames
rownames(overlap.975) <- groupnames
colnames(overlap.975) <- groupnames

overlap.2.5
overlap.40
overlap.975

write.table(overlap.2.5, file = "Data/Pike/Niche-overlap2.5-phenotypes.txt")
write.table(overlap.40, file = "Data/Pike/Niche-overlap40-phenotypes.txt")
write.table(overlap.975, file = "Data/Pike/Niche-overlap97.5-phenotypes.txt")

overlap.2.5 <- read.table("Data/Pike/Niche-overlap2.5-phenotypes.txt")
overlap.40 <-  read.table("Data/Pike/Niche-overlap40-phenotypes.txt")
overlap.975 <- read.table("Data/Pike/Niche-overlap97.5-phenotypes.txt")
```

```{r individual overlap metrics phenotype-level, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Anadromous <- subset(Ecopike2, phenotype == "Anadromous")

source("funcs.R")

mus_FW <- Freshwater%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  reframe(fish_ID,
          d13C = mean(d13C, na.rm = T),

  drop_na(d13C, d15N, d34S)%>%

mus_Cross <- Crosshabitat%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  reframe(fish_ID,

          d34S = mean(d34S, na.rm = T))%>%
  drop_na(d13C, d15N, d34S)%>%
  distinct()

mus_BW <- Brackish%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  reframe(fish_ID,
          d13C = mean(d13C, na.rm = T),
          d15N = mean(d15N, na.rm = T),
          d34S = mean(d34S, na.rm = T))%>%
  drop_na(d13C, d15N, d34S)%>%
  distinct()

PikeID_FW <- unique(mus_FW$fish_ID)
PikeID_Ana <- unique(mus_Ana$fish_ID)

overlap_Ana <- data.frame(fish_ID = NA, overlap = NA)

    over<-CubeCount3D(c(mus_FW[mus_FW$fish_ID == PikeID_FW[i],]$d13C, 
                        mus_FW[mus_FW$fish_ID == PikeID_FW[i],]$d15N,

                         c(mean(Freshwater$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d34S, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      Individuals[[PikeID_FW[i]]],
                      TNWmat_FW)
  }
  overlap_FW[i,1] <- PikeID_FW[i]
  overlap_FW[i,2] <- over/SEV.function(TNWmat_FW)
}

for(i in 1:length(PikeID_Ana)){{
    over<-CubeCount3D(c(mus_Ana[mus_Ana$fish_ID == PikeID_Ana[i],]$d13C, 
                        mus_Ana[mus_Ana$fish_ID == PikeID_Ana[i],]$d15N, 
                        mus_Ana[mus_Ana$fish_ID == PikeID_Ana[i],]$d34S),
                         c(mean(Freshwater$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d34S, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      Individuals[[PikeID_Ana[i]]],
                      TNWmat_Ana)
  }
  overlap_Ana[i,1] <- PikeID_Ana[i]
  overlap_Ana[i,2] <- over/SEV.function(TNWmat_Ana)
}

for(i in 1:length(PikeID_Cross)){{
    over<-CubeCount3D(c(mus_Cross[mus_Cross$fish_ID == PikeID_Cross[i],]$d13C, 
                        mus_Cross[mus_Cross$fish_ID == PikeID_Cross[i],]$d15N, 
                        mus_Cross[mus_Cross$fish_ID == PikeID_Cross[i],]$d34S),
                         c(mean(Freshwater$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d34S, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      Individuals[[PikeID_Cross[i]]],
                      TNWmat_Cross)
  }
  overlap_Cross[i,1] <- PikeID_Cross[i]
  overlap_Cross[i,2] <- over/SEV.function(TNWmat_Cross)
}

for(i in 1:length(PikeID_BW)){{
    over<-CubeCount3D(c(mus_BW[mus_BW$fish_ID == PikeID_BW[i],]$d13C, 
                        mus_BW[mus_BW$fish_ID == PikeID_BW[i],]$d15N, 
                        mus_BW[mus_BW$fish_ID == PikeID_BW[i],]$d34S),
                         c(mean(Freshwater$d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
                           mean(Freshwater$d34S, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      Individuals[[PikeID_BW[i]]],
                      TNWmat_BW)
  }
  overlap_BW[i,1] <- PikeID_BW[i]
  overlap_BW[i,2] <- over/SEV.function(TNWmat_BW)
}

overlap <- rbind(overlap_FW, overlap_Ana, overlap_Cross, overlap_BW)

Overlap_pheno <- Ecopike2%>%
  left_join(overlap, by = "fish_ID")
fwrite(Ecopike3, "Data/Pike/Pike_eco-clean-cbackcalculated_so-metric_phenotypes.csv")

#compare to individual overlap with population TINW
Overlap_pop <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_eco-clean-cbackcalculated_so-metric.csv")

Opop <- ggplot(Overlap_pop, aes(phenotype, overlap, fill = phenotype))+
  geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.2)+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks = c("FW_resident", "Anadromous", "Trans-habitat", "BW-resident"),
                    values = c("#C5D86D", "#00BFB2", "#F1C40F", "#004643"),

  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("FW_resident", "Anadromous", "Trans-habitat", "BW-resident"),
                   labels = c("freshwater resident", "anadromous", "cross-habitat", "brackish resident"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0,1, 0.25))+
  labs(title = "overlap with population TINW",
       fill = "behavioral phenotype")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_blank())


Opheno <- ggplot(overlap_pheno, aes(phenotype, overlap, fill = phenotype))+

  scale_x_discrete(breaks = c("FW_resident", "Anadromous", "Trans-habitat", "BW-resident"),

        axis.title = element_blank())

Overlap_compare <- annotate_figure(ggarrange(Opop, Opheno, common.legend = T, legend = "right"),

                                   left = text_grob("overlap index", size = 8, rot = 90, hjust = 0))
```

```{r data prep, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Data <- fread("Data/Pike/Pikedata-eye-lens-years.csv")

Data2 <- Data%>%
  drop_na(d34S_mean)%>%
  reframe(ID = ID,
          ID2 = as.numeric(factor(ID)),
          sex = sex,
          TL_mm = TL_mm,
          length_back = length_back,
          lifeyear = lifeyear,
          waterbody = as.factor(waterbody),
          phenotype = case_when(phenotype == "FW_resident"~"FW-resident",
                                   TRUE~phenotype),
          phenotype_num = case_when(phenotype == "FW-resident" ~ 1,
                                  phenotype == "Anadromous" ~ 2,
                                  phenotype == "Trans-habitat" ~ 3,
                                  phenotype == "BW-resident" ~ 4),
          res_mean = res_mean,
          Sr_mean = Sr_mean,
          d13C = (d13C_mean+(max(sqrt(d13C_mean^2)))),
          d15N = d15N_mean,
          d34S = d34S_mean,
          CN = CN_mean)

fwrite(Data2, file = "Data/Pike/Pikedata_Stan.csv")
```

```{r compare models, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

base <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_base.rds")
CNS_CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CNS_CN.rds")
CNS <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CNS.rds")
CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CS.rds")
NS <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_NS.rds")
CN <- readRDS("Data/pike/fit_gamma_diet_CN.rds")

fits = list(base = fit_base, CNS_CN = fit_CNS_CN, CNS = fit_CNS, CN = fit_CN, CS = fit_CS, NS = fit_NS)

loos = lapply(fits, loo, pars = "log_lik")

looics = sapply(loos, function(x) x$estimates['looic', 'Estimate'])
delta_looic = looics - min(looics)
wi = exp(-0.5*delta_looic) / sum(exp(-0.5*delta_looic))
round(rbind(looic = looics, dlooic = delta_looic, weight = wi), 2)
```

```{r age length key from pike scales and otoliths, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

#Remove BH-90239, BH-90324, BH-90105, BH-90019, BH-90112

Pikescales <- fread("Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%filter(!fish_ID %in% c("BH-90239", "BH-90324", "BH-90105", "BH-90019", "BH-90112", "BH-90037"))

lm.scale <- lm(TL_mm~total_rad, data = Pikescales)

summary(lm.scale)

ggplot(Pikescales, aes(x = TL_mm, y = total_rad))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()

a <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[1]]
b <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[2]]

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_back = (rad/total_rad)*(TL_mm-a)+a)

Pikeages <- Pikescales%>%
  transmute(length = length_back/10,
            sex=sex,
            age = lifeyear)%>%
  mutate(lcat5 = lencat(length, w = 5))%>%
  distinct()

#length frequency table
alk.freq <- xtabs(~lcat5+age, data = Pikeages)
rowSums(alk.freq)

#probability table of age at length
alk <- prop.table(alk.freq, margin = 1)
round(alk, 3)

#run multinominal log-linear models, increase iterations to converge
agemodel1 <- multinom(age ~ lcat5, data = Pikeages, maxit = 1000)
agemodel2 <- multinom(age ~ lcat5*sex, data = Pikeages, maxit = 1000)

anova(agemodel1, agemodel2)
#who would´ve thought, sex is highly significant...

length_sim <- seq(min(Pikeages$lcat5), max(Pikeages$lcat5), 5)
dfF <- data.frame(lcat5 = length_sim, sex = "f")
dfM <- data.frame(lcat5 = length_sim, sex = "m")

alkF <- predict(agemodel2, dfF, type = "probs")
rownames(alkF) <- length_sim
alkPlot(alkF, type = "area", pal = "grey", xlab = "total lengt (cm)", showLegend = TRUE, leg.cex = 0.7)
alkPlot(alkF,type="bubble",xlab="Total Length (mm)")

alkM <- predict(agemodel2, dfM, type = "probs")
rownames(alkM) <- length_sim
alkPlot(alkM, type = "area", pal = "grey", xlab = "total lengt (cm)", showLegend = TRUE, leg.cex = 0.7)
alkPlot(alkM,type="bubble",xlab="Total Length (mm)")
```

```{r cleanup scale data, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
            waterbody=waterbody,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            cohort=cohort,
            pisc=pisc,
            lifeyear=yearcont,
            year=year,
            inc_mm=inc_mm,
            rad=rad,
            total_rad=max(rad))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  distinct()

ggplot(pikeages_final2, aes(waterbody, inc_mm))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_minimal()

fwrite(pikeages_final2, "Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")
```

```{r combine scale data with isotopes, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike1 <- fread("C:/Users/timor/Nextcloud2/Boddenhecht/Data/Pike Data/1.pike_data_base_FOR_USERS/1Pike_Latest_Version.txt")

Pike2 <- Pike1%>%

            weight=Weight,
            TL_mm=Total_Length_mm,
            Recap=MarkorRecap,
            Tele=case_when(is.na(Transmitter_Num)==FALSE~"Yes",
                           TRUE~"NA"))%>%
  filter(Tele == "Yes")%>%
  distinct()

PikeSI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike_SI_all_clean_average_lipid-corrected.csv")

Transcheck <- Pike2 %>%
  left_join(PikeSI, by = "ID")%>%
  transmute(ID, Tele, d13C, d15N, d34S)%>%
  drop_na(d13C)%>%
  distinct()

length(unique(Transcheck$ID))

Pikescales <- fread("Data/Pike/Transmitter-pike-ages-with-TL.csv")

#Check for which fish both data are there
Pike2 <- Pike%>%
  transmute(ID=ID,
            area=area,
            SI="Yes")%>%
  distinct()

Pikescales2 <- Pikescales%>%
  transmute(ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            Scaleage="Yes")

Pikecheck <- Pikescales2%>%
  left_join(Pike2, by = "ID")%>%
  distinct()

length(Pikecheck[Pikecheck$SI=="Yes"]$ID)

#Prepare join
Pike.SI <- Pike%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=ID,
            species=Species,
            d15N=d15N,
            d13C=d13C,
            d34S=d34S,
            CN_ratio=CN_ratio)

#Backcalculate length
ggplot(Pikescales, aes(total_rad, TL_mm))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  theme_minimal()

lm.scale <- lm(TL_mm~total_rad, data = Pikescales)

summary(lm.scale)

a <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[1]]
b <- coefficients(lm.scale)[[2]]

Pikescales <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_back = (rad/total_rad)*(TL_mm-a)+a)

#Prepare age-corrected growth index
Pikescales[, length_age_plus_1 := shift(length_back, type = "lead"), by = fish_ID]

#linear regression of inc+1 with inc
length.mod <- lm(length_age_plus_1~length_back, data = Pikescales)
summary(length.mod)

length_slope <- coefficients(length.mod)[[2]]
#Predict increment for each year
Pikescales2 <- Pikescales%>%
  mutate(length_predict=length_back*length_slope)

Pikescales2[, length_predict := shift(length_back, type = "lag"), by = fish_ID]

ggplot(Pikescales, aes(length_back, length_age_plus_1))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")+
  theme_minimal()

Pikescales.final <- Pikescales2%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            date=date,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            TL_mm=TL_mm,
            weight_g=weight_g,
            sex=sex,
            age=as.factor(age),
            pisc=pisc,
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            inc_mm,
            growth_index=length_back-length_predict)%>%
  group_by(fish_ID)%>%
  filter(lifeyear==last(lifeyear))

#join with isotopes
Pike.scales.SI <- Pikescales.final%>%
  inner_join(Pike.SI, by = "fish_ID")

pl_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"))

C <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d13C))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme

N <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d15N))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme


S <- ggplot(Pike.scales.SI, aes(age, growth_index, color = d34S))+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Age-corrected growth")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1, 13, 2))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()+
  theme_minimal()+
  pl_theme


CNS <- ggarrange(C, N, S, nrow = 1)

ggsave("Figures/CNS-plot-growth-index.png", CNS, width = 15, height = 5, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
fwrite(Pike.scales.SI, "Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")
```

```{r modelling growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike.scales.SI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")

Pike.scales.Si2 <- Pike.scales.SI%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            pisc_scale=scale(pisc),
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            growth_index=growth_index,
            d15N_scale=scale(d15N),
            d13C_scale=scale(d13C),
            d34S_scale=scale(d34S),
            CN_scale=scale(CN_ratio))%>%
  drop_na(growth_index)

ggplot(Pike.scales.Si2, aes(waterbody,growth_index))+
  geom_boxplot()

Pikemodel.1 <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+pisc_scale+d15N_scale+d13C_scale+d34S_scale+CN_scale+d15N_scale*d13C_scale*d34S_scale+(1|waterbody), REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

summary(Pikemodel.1)

#Look at variance inflation factors
pike.vif <- vif(Pikemodel.1)

barplot(pike.vif[,3], main = "VIF values", horiz = F, col = "darkgreen", ylim = c(0,6),
        las = 2)
abline(h = 5, lwd = 3, lty = 2, col="red")

#test effects
rand(Pikemodel.1)

#test threeway interaction
Pikemodel.nointer <- update(Pikemodel.1, ~.-d15N_scale*d13C_scale*d34S_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1, Pikemodel.nointer)

#remove threeway
Pikemodel.1.1 <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+pisc_scale+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

#test sex
Pikemodel.nosex <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-sex)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nosex)
#sex is significant

#test age
Pikemodel.noage <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noage)
#age is significant

#test piscivory
Pikemodel.nopisc <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-pisc_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nopisc)
#Piscivory is not significant

#test d15N
Pikemodel.noN <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d15N_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noN)
#d15N is not significant

#test d13C
Pikemodel.noC <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d13C_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noC)
#d13C is significant

#Test d34S
Pikemodel.noS <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-age*d34S_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.noS)
#d34S is significant

#test CN_ratio
Pikemodel.nofat <- update(Pikemodel.1.1, ~.-CN_scale)

anova(Pikemodel.1.1, Pikemodel.nofat)
#CN-ratio not significant
```

```{r model summary, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Pikemodel.final <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

summary(Pikemodel.final)
r.squaredGLMM(Pikemodel.final)
tab_model(Pikemodel.final)

plot(Pike.scales.Si2$age, Pike.scales.Si2$growth_index)
```

```{r model eval, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
Pike.scales.Si2$resid <- resid(Pikemodel.final)

plot(Pikemodel.final, xlab = "Fitted", ylab = "Residuals")

hist(Pike.scales.Si2$resid, main = "", xlab = "Residuals")

qqnorm(resid(Pikemodel.final))
qqline(resid(Pikemodel.final))

par(mfrow=c(2,3))
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~as.factor(Pike.scales.Si2$sex), ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Sex")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$age, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "Age")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d15N")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d13C")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "d34S")
plot(Pike.scales.Si2$resid~Pike.scales.Si2$CN_scale, ylab = "Residuals", xlab = "C:N ratio")
```

```{r predict growth, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

Pike.scales.SI <- fread("Data/Pike/Pike-data-SI-growth.csv")

Pike.scales.Si2 <- Pike.scales.SI%>%
  transmute(fish_ID=fish_ID,
            waterbody=waterbody,
            sex=sex,
            age=age,
            pisc_scale=scale(pisc),
            lifeyear=lifeyear,
            growth_index=growth_index,
            d15N_scale=scale(d15N),
            d13C_scale=scale(d13C),
            d34S_scale=scale(d34S),
            CN_scale=scale(CN_ratio))%>%
  drop_na(growth_index)

Pikemodel.final <- lmer(growth_index~sex+age+age*d15N_scale+age*d13C_scale+age*d34S_scale+CN_scale+(1|waterbody), 
                      REML = T, data = Pike.scales.Si2)

sex <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$sex)
age <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$age)
waterbody <- unique(Pike.scales.Si2$waterbody)
d15N <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d15N_scale), 3.4)
d13C <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d13C_scale), 1)
d34S <- seq(min(Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale), max(Pike.scales.Si2$d34S_scale), 1)
CN_ratio <- mean(Pike.scales.Si2$CN_scale)

Newdata <- expand.grid(sex=sex,
                       age=age,
                       d15N_scale=d15N,
                       d13C_scale=d13C,
                       d34S_scale=d34S,
                       CN_scale=CN_ratio,
                       waterbody=waterbody)

head(Newdata)

Newdata$prediction <- predict(Pikemodel.final, newdata = Newdata, allow.new.levels = TRUE, type = "response")

pl_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.key.size = unit(.5, "cm"),
                  legend.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"))

C <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d13C_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d13C", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

N <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d15N_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d15N", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

S <- ggplot(Newdata, aes(d34S_scale, prediction))+
  geom_point(size = .2)+
  labs(x = "scaled d34S", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()+
  pl_theme

ggplot(Newdata, aes(as.factor(waterbody), prediction))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x = "Age", y = "predicted growth index")+
  theme_bw()

CNS <- ggarrange(C, N, S, nrow = 1)

ggsave("Figures/CNS-plot-predicted.png", CNS, width = 15, height = 5, units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
